name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers

meta.next: Keep An Eye Out, The Bloodsail Buccaneers (2), Up to Snuff

summary: Along the Savage Coast, rumors of rival pirates trouble the newly arrived Blackwater Raiders. First Mate Crazz sends you to scout a cove while his crew drinks and seeks company in Booty Bay.

sections.title: A Scout along the Savage Coast
sections.body: The Blackwater Raiders have just docked in Booty Bay when word reaches them of rivals across southern Stranglethorn Vale. The crew is busy with grog and company ashore, so First Mate Crazz asks you to go in their place. Head north along the Savage Coast and scout a cove for signs of what the Bloodsail Buccaneers are doing.

sections.title: Signs in the Cove
sections.body: In the cove, you find a barrel with a map resting on top. Hastily scribbled notes cover it, and some coins lie beside it.

faq.answer: First Mate Crazz is an officer among the Blackwater Raiders in Booty Bay. Rumors of rival pirates are spreading, and his crew is busy ashore, so he hires passing adventurers to scout the coast.

faq.q: Why does First Mate Crazz need an outsider?
aliases: why cant his crew do it
faq.answer: The Blackwater crew has only just docked and is too busy carousing ashore to scout the coast themselves.

faq.q: Where does Crazz send you to investigate?
faq.answer: Crazz sends you to a cove immediately north of Booty Bay, along the Savage Coast.

faq.q: What rivalry is troubling the Blackwater Raiders?
faq.answer: The Blackwater Raiders are in a bitter feud with the Bloodsail Buccaneers, who have recently been seen across southern Stranglethorn Vale.
